positions.thesis: AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a five-year extreme while NZDUSD still sits in the cheap tail at 0.5627. That cross has stretched far beyond a 30-basis-point Australia versus New Zealand 10-year gap, and it is the only concentrated, asymmetric swing on a firm tape. Short the cross as a real swing; oil remaining bid is the accepted tax, not a reason to stay flat. CORRA March stays closed: 2.55 cash versus 2.925 is the same leftover path already booked into the event-implied print, not a new dislocation…

pms.thesis: AUDNZD at 1.228 is still in the 82nd percentile after a 1.39 percent five-day decline, so the short from 1.25 is ahead without having closed the gap between a heavy Australian dollar and a kiwi that is up 1.26 percent and still near a one-year low. The existing 300 million short is already the full concentrated expression. A squeeze back through the entry is the adverse path being carried, and adding would only stack the same cross. October CPI is unreleased, so no new dollar or US-rate risk is put on before the print.
